title: You've (Likely) Been Playing The Game Of Life Wrong
summary: Veritasium explains why many real-world systems follow power laws rather than normal distributions. It covers self-organized criticality, with simulations of sandpiles, magnetism and forest fires.
why: HN commenters recommend it for changing how they think about distributions and for showing how criticality shows up across earthquakes, wildfires and other fields.

quote.text: Before I watched this I would default to thinking about most distributions as normal.
